scope: Historical private predictions from the selected step-436 models, not fresh Docker inference.

definitions.whitespace_tokens_identical: Python re.findall(r"\S+", text) is identical in content and order before and after formatting.
definitions.non_whitespace_characters_identical: Removing Python regex whitespace with re.sub(r"\s+", "", text) yields identical character sequences, including digits and punctuation.
definitions.ordinary_internal_spaces_preserved: For corresponding internal token gaps, compare equality only where neither old nor new gap contains CR/LF/tab or a run of two spaces. Layout gaps may change.
definitions.row_identity: Compare unique (sample_id, direction) pairs with private source_language mapped en->en-vi and vi->vi-en.
definitions.content_preservation: Relative to the raw VinAI translation, not a claim of source-faithful meaning or complete translation.

original_formatting_audit_summary.method: same Qwen layout transfer used on best60 private output
original_formatting_audit_summary.limitation: Same-language anchor interpolation is not certification of exact source whitespace/cell semantic correspondence.
